source_interfaces.role: mutable preprocessing and generated run artifacts
source_interfaces.read_policy: immutable source; inventory only after human approval

source_interfaces.role: legacy dataset repository and current audio metadata
source_interfaces.read_policy: immutable source; never rewrite in place

inventory_summary.why_remote_counts_are_unknown: This repository task is intentionally offline and the conflict policy prohibits remote reads unless a human approves the inventory step. No remote object count, byte count, revision, or cost is inferred from local manifests.

known_local_inputs.role: checked-in legacy response source; not a bucket inventory

local_build_evidence.interpretation: These are reproducible local normalization results for the checked-in text manifest. They are not claims about the remote bucket, and missing audio remains visible as a warning under the permissive builder policy.

rules: Raw run output is append-only and date/run scoped.
Curated files are content-addressed by release manifest and are never overwritten in place.
Indexes, manifests, batch wrappers, summaries, and logs stay under manifests/ or raw/ and never enter a config directory.
Audio bytes remain external to audio metadata rows; every published audio row carries a full SHA-256.

dataset_repo.legacy_prefix_policy: retain audio/abby-tts/current/ unchanged until a separately approved deprecation

steps.action: capture a read-only source inventory and checksum each object
build and check local canonical JSONL, quarantine, warnings, and manifest artifacts
write one schema-stable Parquet family per config and split, then validate columns and checksums
produce a file-by-file copy/upload manifest for human review; do not pass --upload
compare the approved local release manifest with the proposed immutable bucket prefix; report additions and checksum mismatches only
no delete, move, overwrite, or force-upload operation is proposed

delete_plan.reason: Rollback must be possible without reconstructing mutable source data.

checksums_counts_costs.checksum_policy: SHA-256 every source object and every emitted Parquet shard; include byte length, row count, schema version, and release manifest digest.
count_reconciliation: source rows = accepted rows + quarantined rows
each config split count equals its Parquet row count
provenance subjects resolve to an emitted response, template, or audio row
published audio byte length and SHA-256 match the external object

remote_estimates.cost_formula: max(0, upload_bytes - already_matching_bytes) * provider_transfer_rate + retained_bytes * provider_storage_rate
remote_estimates.why_null: A cost estimate without a remote inventory would imply an unverified bucket state.

local_preflight: load each config with pyarrow or datasets using only its own Parquet paths
assert the exact schema_version and fixed column types from docs/data/ABBY_VOICE_DATASET_SCHEMA.md
assert train, validation, and test paths do not overlap
validate row counts, full SHA-256 manifest entries, references, consent/license publication gates, and quarantine reconciliation
load at least one row from every non-empty config/split without importing batch wrappers, indexes, or manifests
remote_viewer_after_approval: open each named config in Dataset Viewer and verify all declared splits load
check that no split reports a schema inference error or mixed-type column
compare Viewer row counts and config names with the signed release receipt
sample response-to-template, response-to-audio, and response-to-provenance references
retain the Viewer URL, dataset revision, timestamp, and screenshot or API response digest
dataset_viewer_validation.failure_action: do not publish or change a release pointer; quarantine the release candidate and repair locally

rollback.before_publication: discard only the local staging directory after preserving its manifest and review receipt
rollback.after_publication: repoint the consumer to the last approved dataset revision or release manifest; leave the failed release and all legacy source prefixes intact
